pages.title: Frozen Light Ore
pages.text: Photons that fell toward a horizon and appear to have stopped. To any outside observer, their final moments are stretched forever, so the ore glows a deep, slow red that never fades. It is not hot, merely luminous and patient.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Seen from far away, anything falling into a black hole freezes at the horizon. In infall rock I found veins of that frozen light, caught at the instant it crossed and preserved there indefinitely.
$(thing)Found$(): in veins through the black hole interior (mine it for its drop).
